llm.summary: CPRI was on the watch list, had a negative excess return and was stopped on premature noise, indicating both an outcome failure and a process fault.
llm.root_cause: CPRI was on the watch list, had a negative excess return and was stopped on premature noise, indicating both an outcome failure and a process fault.
llm.lesson: The stop engine fired prematurely, but the underlying idea also had a negative outcome, showing the stop masked a real break.
llm.engines_credit: The signal engine failed to identify an idiosyncratic break; the stop engine added noise on top.

causal_chain.mechanism: Idiosyncratic negative break appeared post-entry, making the position lose value.
causal_chain.counterfactual: If no premature stop, the position would have incurred a larger loss, so stop prevented further damage.
evidence_refs: Pick data: idio_break, negative excess return

causal_chain.mechanism: Entry was on the watch list at a time when stock-specific conditions were deteriorating.
causal_chain.counterfactual: If entry had been avoided, no loss would have occurred.

causal_chain.mechanism: Premature stop was triggered by noise, classifying the exit as an avoidable process fault.
causal_chain.counterfactual: If no premature stop, the position would have remained open, but the loss would be larger.

alternate_explanations: The stop may have been correctly placed, and the negative move was not just noise but a strong break that would have stopped out anyway.
The outcome could be due to a Consumer Discretionary sector-wide selloff.
missing_evidence: Intraday data around the stop trigger

signal_hypotheses.feature: Ratio of premature stop exits on breaking names vs non-breaking names
signal_hypotheses.measurement: Compute for each stop outcome, the frequency of process_fault=premature_stop_noise for idio_break vs idio_alpha picks
signal_hypotheses.expected_direction: Breaks should have lower ratio (stops are justified), while alpha picks have higher ratio (stops are noise)
signal_hypotheses.falsifier: If ratio is similar, stop noise is not differentiated by outcome type.
